resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Install from package manager or website; use with GGA-PBE functional and ultrasoft pseudopotentials. The agent may choose any comparable DFT code (e.g., CASTEP, VASP) but an open-source route is available.
Public SSSP library or similar standard pseudopotential set for Bi, O, I (SSSP efficiency PBE).
Construct from literature: tetragonal, a=b=3.984 Å, c=9.128 Å, space group P4/nmn (No. 129). Atomic positions from standard Wyckoff sites (e.g., ICSD). No external file download required.
